==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:uder|fr:rechercher|:afeq|re-|search}}
Early Modern {{uder|en|fr|rechercher||to examine closely}}, from {{uder|en|fro|recerchier||to seek, to look for}}, {{surf|en|re-|search|nocap=1}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{a|en|RP}}
** {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈsɜːt͡ʃ/|q=standard}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈɹiːsɜːt͡ʃ/|q=alternative}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɹiˌsɝt͡ʃ/|/ɹiˈsɝt͡ʃ/|/ɹɪ-/|a=GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|En-us-research.ogg|a=California}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈsɜːt͡ʃ/|/ˈɹiːsɜːt͡ʃ/|[ˈɹɪi.sɜːt͡ʃ]|a=AU}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɜː(ɹ)tʃ|s=2}}
* {{hyphenation|en|re|search}}

===Noun===
{{wikidata lexeme|L18021}}
{{en-noun|-|es}}

# {{lb|en|uncountable|countable|_|in some dialects}} [[diligent|Diligent]] [[inquiry]] or [[examination]] to seek or [[revise]] facts, [[principle]]s, [[theory|theories]], [[application]]s, etc. (that are currently available, or that are familiar to oneself).
#: ''The '''research''' station that houses Wang and his team is outside Lijiang, a city of about 1.2 million people.'' [[File:The research station that houses Wang and his team is outside Lijiang.ogg]]
# {{lb|en|countable|dated}} A particular instance or piece of research.
#* {{RQ:Macaulay History of England|chapter=1|passage=The dearest interests of parties have frequently been staked on the results of the '''researches''' of antiquaries.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1747|journal=The Scots magazine|volume=9|page=567
|passage=The first step I took in this so necessary a '''research''', was to examine the motives, the justice, the necessity and expediency of the revolution{{...}}}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|author=|title=Zoology. A. General, including Embryology and Histology of the Vertebrata. Development of Muscle-fibres and their Union with Nerves| journal={{w|Journal of Microscopy|Journal of the Royal Microscopical Society}}| year=1883| month=December| volume=3| issue=6| page=[https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/epdf/10.1111/j.1365-2818.1883.tb05959.x 821]| passage=Although very numerous '''researches''' have been made on the differentiation of striped muscles, and on the termination of their motor nerve-fibres, yet the multifarious observations have often been too incomplete to lead to any but conflicting and unsatisfactory theories.}}

===Verb===
{{wikidata lexeme|L115}}
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To search or examine with continued care; to seek diligently.
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To make an extensive investigation into.
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To search again.
# {{lb|en|intransitive|marketing}} To receive a certain response in [[market research]].
#: {{ux|en|Agency and bank staff told the newspaper the ad '''researched''' well.}}
